trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with a central convergence angle of approximately 55-65 degrees; the vertex is partially obscured by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude jagged serrations (at least 5 distinct peaks) localized on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe; the left lobe trailing edge displays low-amplitude, smooth scalloping.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a sharp upward trajectory; trailing edges show concave curves leading to acute distal tips, while leading/outer edges show a smooth convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast clusters of circular white and tan pixel groups concentrated on the distal tips and trailing edges of both lobes, identifying heavy barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive accumulation of calcified acorn barnacles on the tips; the right lobe's inner trailing edge shows significant irregular tissue loss/jaggedness compared to the left lobe.
